coverage: Authenticated existing-session catalog and snapshot; provider credentials and opaque provider payloads omitted
Command-ID reservation, duplicate receipts, differing-input rejection, reconnect without replay
In-flight model selection survives a dropped HTTP response and can be reconciled by receipt
Desktop conversation switch and branch retain the listener and invalidate old commands
One streaming message identity becomes the persisted host answer
Consecutive assistant messages sharing a timestamp retain distinct streaming identities
Complete write inputs become exact artifacts; truncated inputs do not
Subagents cannot replace the main session; approval notifications cannot become approval commands
Unconfirmed prompt admission remains guarded until an explicit idle host reset
A full receipt ledger rejects new commands without evicting old IDs
Missing receipts return HTTP 404 after a host conversation change instead of inventing a new identity
Compaction and tree navigation clear completed event overlays and change generation
Snapshot and request limits; browser origin, path, method, and field restrictions
The newest tool result survives the response budget while older conversation rows are omitted
Private setup reuse, no credential logging, owner-only files, no symlinks or checkout credential paths

Real stock OMP InteractiveMode and its extension UI controller over one SDK AgentSession
modes.terminal: Synthetic output recorder injected through the public Composer terminal option; not a VT emulator

Public sendUserMessage enters the same real session; duplicate command ID does not add a second model call
Phone reconnect reads preserve the host process and do not replay prompts
Public abort stops a delayed real agent turn while preserving the process and listener
Public model selection updates the same session using host-configured model metadata
A real host newSession transition changes conversation and generation, retains the listener, and rejects an old command
The real session_shutdown lifecycle event closes the extension listener

Native Android, GrapheneOS, a physical Pixel, or background socket behavior

OMP or host crash recovery, persisted command receipts, or exactly-once external tool effects
